item.title: github: Opt-in dist-tag permissions for npm trusted publishing
item.description:
npm trusted publishing can now optionally get permission to manage dist-tags using short-lived OIDC credentials. This covers actions like moving tags such as latest, next, and beta without using long-lived credentials.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Multiple trusted publishing configurations for npm
item.description:
GitHub says three npm publishing updates are now generally available, including support for multiple trusted publishing configurations per package. The post also mentions staged publishing and another publishing-related change, but the provided excerpt does not include the full details.

  • Source: GitHub
